title: Praxis Chess evidence graph, version 2
description: Every fact about one chess mistake, computed from the board and a deterministic Stockfish search (1 thread, hash cleared, depth 14). Nothing here is a label: labels come from the rules (praxis_eval.rules) applied on top. Squares are lowercase ("c3"), pieces are lowercase names ("knight"), sides are "WHITE"/"BLACK", moves are SAN unless a field says UCI, and evaluations are pawns from White's point of view unless a field says otherwise. Written by EvidenceGraphBuilder (Java, the Praxis repository); the headless GraphCli builds one for any position. Field names are snake_case; a null field is omitted.

header.description: What position, whose move, and how it was searched.

player.description: The side that made the mistake.

ply.description: Half-move number of the mistake in its game.

p0.description: P0, the position before the move.

best.description: B, the engine's best move at P0.

reply.description: R1, the opponent's critical reply after M, and the line it starts walked to the consequence (PC). Counted from the position after M, with M's own capture at ply 0.

losses.description: The player's pieces that changed hands.

gains.description: The opponent's pieces that changed hands.

net_loss.description: Pawns the player is down at the end of the line.

played_line.description: M and the line after it, from P0.

best_line.description: B and the line after it, from P0.

cf1.description: CF1, the counterfactual: R1 played after the engine's move instead of M.

loss_after_best.description: Pawns the player would lose to R1 after B, against P0's value; absent when R1 is illegal there.

parries.description: R1 does not work after B: illegal, or worth under a pawn.

t1.description: T1, the null-move probe at P0: what the opponent threatened before M, and whether R1 was already that threat.

probed.description: False when the probe cannot run (the player was in check).

cost.description: Pawns the player loses by passing.

reply_cost.description: Pawns the player loses if the opponent plays R1 with a free move.

delta.description: Δ items: what M changed for pieces that did not move, and lines it opened or closed. Δn is the n-th item, whatever a budgeted rendering drops.

geometry.description: G items: tactic geometry created by R1.

by.description: Square of the piece making the tactic.

best_effects.description: B.e items: what B does in its own right.

moved_effects.description: M.e items: what M does in its own right.

d1.description: D1, visibility: when the engine first saw M was bad, and kept seeing it.

back_rank_mate.description: The played line ends in a back-rank mate (motif BACK_RANK comes from this, not from geometry).

capture_see.description: For a capture, what the capture sequence gains.

landing_see.description: Static exchange value on the destination square after the move, from the mover's side: negative means the piece can be won.

net_loss.description: Pawns the player is down at the end; negative means the line wins material.
